title: The State of Crypto Markets w/ Ryan Connor of RockawayX
summary: In this episode of Galaxy Grid, Rockaway X's Ryan Connor joins to examine the market's upward momentum as Bitcoin tests $88K on the back of $2.4B in weekly ETF inflows. The discussion covers crypto's resilience against macro headwinds, Rockaway X's strategy for bringing esoteric real-world assets (RWAs) like private reinsurance onchain, and recent SEC and CFTC regulatory updates. The panel also debates whether AI agents could trigger deposit flight from traditional banks and analyzes Ethereum's evolving commercial identity.
